# D10.1 exploratory analysis (generated by `python -m polysafe.exploratory`)

**Exploratory and hypothesis-generating; specified after the section 8 and D8.1 results were seen (PREREGISTRATION D10.1). It does not replace the primary result.** U = 1 if the stay has a counted medication row (D6.4) with no drugname and a HICL code.

Primary result: dAUROC +0.036 (95% BCa 0.006 to 0.071).

| Analysis | Comparison | AUROC without | AUROC with | dAUROC (95% BCa) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| E1 | clinical + U vs clinical | 0.641 | 0.640 | -0.001 (-0.006 to 0.003) |
| E2 | clinical + medication + U vs clinical + U | 0.640 | 0.675 | +0.035 (0.006 to 0.070) |

## U by AKI status (stays)

| u_unnamed_hicl_row | AKI | no AKI |
|---|---|---|
| U = 0 | 6 | 49 |
| U = 1 | 69 | 527 |
| no record | 3 | 17 |

Hospitals in the primary cohort: 141; share of stays with U = 1 by hospital: median 1.00, hospitals with U = 1 in every stay 104, in no stay 3.

Reading stated in D10.1 before the run: if E2 stays near the primary gain, U does not explain it; if E2 falls towards 0 while E1 carries the gain, the record-process explanation is supported. Neither outcome is confirmatory.
